body:
A while back I found some of my grandfather's viagra pills, which he rarely took, and took about five or so out of experimentation. Naturally, I got a long-lasting wood from it but it also messed with my vision. When I waved my hands slowly in front of my face, I'd see  a kind of 'trail' of my arm as it passed over my eyes. Though I was a bit alarmed because I wondered if I gave myself brain damage or something, I still enjoyed both experiences.
